purpose: Adapters for Mexico, Brazil, Sweden, Israel and South African microscope-slide collection entries added in 07H.
guards: Preserve mixed-media counts exactly; do not turn combined slide/vial or thin-section/slide totals into pure slide counts.
Treat slide-mounted specimen counts and physical slide counts as different count ontologies unless the source explicitly equates them.
Keep named historical subcollections, donors, transfers, remounting programmes and storage changes as separate provenance layers.

adapters.target: Coleccion Nacional de Acaros collection page
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture mixed slide/vial preservation, type counts, database links and exchange geography without manufacturing a slide subtotal.

adapters.institution_scope: Colecao Entomologica do Instituto Oswaldo Cruz
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve each named historical collection separately and keep slide counts distinct from alcohol-tube counts.

adapters.institution_scope: Swedish Museum of Natural History Herbarium
adapters.target: herbarium history and palynological collection page
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture founder, laboratory date, institutional succession and collection-scale slide count.

adapters.institution_scope: Swedish Museum of Natural History Palaeontology
adapters.promotion_rule: Keep media qualified as microscopic preparations/specimens until item records confirm slide mounting; capture database endpoint and identification status.
Preserve the mixed thin-section-or-slide wording and collection geography; never use the mixed total as a pure slide count.

adapters.institution_scope: ARC Plant Protection Research Institute NCA-Acari
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture slide-mounted count, named donor subsets, type counts, remounting/resealing and cabinet-to-plastic-box storage transition as separate evidence layers.

adapters.institution_scope: ARC Plant Protection Research Institute National Collection of Nematodes
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve slide-to-specimen multiplicity, named subcollections, former institutional custody and survey-derived collections separately.

adapters.institution_scope: ARC South African National Collection of Insects
adapters.target: National Collection of Insects specialist holdings page
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture Aphid, Coccoidea, Psylloidea and Whitefly subcollections as separate nodes with sample/accession/slide counts kept distinct.
Capture veterinary-vector slide holdings, species scope and type/reference function; do not assume one slide-mounted specimen equals one physical slide.
